staticFindings.detail: is_file/is_symlink followed by path read reopens the input without descriptor-level O_NOFOLLOW/fstat binding.
The validator report has no sealedPayloadSha256 and PostgreSQL evidence rows are not independently sealed.
Execution uses mutable postgres:16/postgres:18 tags and records neither image ID nor repository digest nor container image equality.
DDL revokes PUBLIC but does not encode or independently verify schema/table owner, migrator/runtime role, NOBYPASSRLS, or positive least-privilege ACL bindings.
Marker searches and column-name-only parsing do not bind exact column types, nullability, defaults, complete constraints, or role semantics.
Resolved parent paths and recursive mkdir allow implicit symlink ancestry; report publication lacks directory fsync and exclusive rename discipline.

requiredRemediation: Require and verify all seven canonical seals plus closed-set manifest file/seal references independently.
Open every input through descriptor-level no-follow regular-file checks and reject symlink roots/ancestors.
Replace check-then-os.replace with OS-level exclusive no-replace directory publication.
Use an allowlisted SQL expression/default grammar and hostile payload tests.
Independently reconstruct handler/query candidate bytes and expected SQL physical shape; compare exact bytes.
Add owner/migrator/runtime role, NOBYPASSRLS, schema/table ownership, ACL and RLS behavior contracts and checks.
Resolve PostgreSQL tags to immutable image IDs/digests, run by ID, verify container binding, seal each evidence row and the final report.
Add hostile tool self-tests that run independently of a zero-static canonical candidate.
